login.title: Sign in to the demo
login.sub: Choose a sample user. There are no passwords and nothing here is a real account.
login.investorDesc: Sees holdings and values. Income and costs are hidden. Can propose a valuation, but only a manager can confirm it.
login.managerDesc: Sees everything about the portfolio. Confirms valuations proposed by someone else. Two managers exist to show separation of duties.
login.adminDesc: Governance only: permissions, audit log and security posture. No access to financial content.

check.feed: Simulated activity is labelled as simulated and never written to the database.

pf.yieldAgg: Aggregate only. Income and cost lines for individual assets are not shown to the Investor role.
pf.incomeSrc: Assets with an active lease in the lease register.
pf.scrubHelp: Move over the chart, or use the left and right arrow keys. Shift jumps six months.

assetx.incomeSrc: Sum of the cash-flow lines for this asset, last 12 months.
assetx.noValuations: No confirmed valuation on file. The current value comes from the seed record.
assetx.riskNote: Deterministic model {version}. Weights and thresholds are in the assumption register.
assetx.r_vacancyNa: Not a let asset, no vacancy exposure

val.title: Valuation
val.lead: Run a valuation with sample assumptions, see exactly how it was built, then send it for review. The model is deterministic: the same inputs always give the same answer.
val.addressHelp: Not geocoded. It is only matched against the names of sample compounds already on record.
val.empty: Enter the property details and run the valuation. The result shows the range, the drivers behind the number and five comparable sales.
val.addressMatch: The address matches the sample compound {compound}.
val.estimateSrc: Hedonic price-per-sqm model, assumption set {id}. Each driver below shows its effect in EGP.
val.cr_dispersion: Comparables disagree by {pct}% (standard deviation of adjusted price per sqm)
val.cr_sameDistrict: All comparables are from the same district
val.cr_mixedDistricts: Some or all comparables are from other districts
val.crossCheck: Cross-check: the comparables alone imply {value}, which is {drift} from the model estimate.
val.dx_base: Area times the sample base price per sqm for {district}.
val.dx_age: Building age of {age} years on a declining curve that flattens at 25 years.
val.dx_floor: Floor {floor}: ground floors carry a penalty and upper floors a premium up to a cap. Villas and land are exempt.
val.dx_market: Market factor {market}: the district's sample index since the first month, damped to 94%.
val.compsNote: Sample sales, ranked by similarity in district, size, recency and finish. Adjusted price strips each sale's own attributes and market timing.
val.noComps: No comparable {type} sales in the sample data. The range is widened and confidence is low.
val.assumptionLine: Assumption set {id}, valuation as of {date}. Sample data.
val.humanHelp: The model proposes; a person decides. Change the final value only with a reason. Adjustments above {pct}% need two approvers.
val.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters ({n} so far). This is recorded in the audit log.
val.reasonMandatory: A reason code and a written reason are mandatory when the final value differs from the model.
val.flowInvestor: An asset manager reviews and confirms. You cannot confirm your own valuation.
val.flowManager: A different asset manager must confirm. Nobody confirms a valuation they proposed.
val.sentOk: Valuation {id} is waiting for review. It needs {n} approval(s) from asset managers other than the proposer.
val.err_invalid: Some of the details are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
val.err_reason_required: A reason code and a written reason of at least 10 characters are required for an adjustment.
val.err_out_of_range: The final value is more than 50% away from the model estimate. Check the number.
val.err_self_approval: You proposed this valuation, so you cannot confirm it.
val.err_already_approved: You have already approved this valuation.
val.err_not_in_review: This valuation is no longer in review.
val.queueLead: Valuations waiting for confirmation. The portfolio and the audit log update when the last required approval is given.
val.confirmedMsg: Confirmed. The portfolio value has been updated.
val.blockedSelf: You proposed this valuation, so you cannot confirm it. A different manager must.
val.blockedAlready: You have already approved this one. A different manager must give the next approval.
val.registerNote: Each set is stored with a SHA-256 hash of its content. A valuation or scenario records the set it used, so it can be reproduced.
val.dx_floor_na: Floor does not apply to villas and land, so this step has no effect.

horus.title: Horus
horus.subtitle: Answers only from your portfolio data, with every claim cited.
horus.welcome: Ask a question and Horus will answer only from the data in this system. Every claim carries a citation you can open. If it cannot verify something, it says so.
horus.cannotVerify: I can't verify that from your portfolio data.
horus.cannotVerifyHelp: Horus only answers from the records it can cite. You could ask about total value, gains, yield, vacancies, lease expiries, document gaps, the largest holdings, district exposure, the market, a valuation, or an asset such as A-001.
horus.advice: Horus does not give investment advice or predictions. AI informs, you decide. Here is what the data shows instead: ask about the portfolio's value, yield, vacancies, lease expiries or market momentum.
horus.droppedNote: {n} statement(s) were removed because they could not be checked against the data.
horus.notice_rate_limit: Live answers are paused for now (hourly limit): scripted answer
horus.modeLive: Live model, checked against the data
horus.modeScripted: Scripted from the same deterministic functions
horus.savedDraft: Saved as draft {id}. A different asset manager must approve it before it can be published.
horus.draftNote: Drafted from the data above. Review before saving; nothing is published automatically.
horus.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved.

horus.s_yield_agg: This is an aggregate figure. Income and costs for individual assets are hidden for your role.
horus.s_units: {units} of the {count} assets have an active lease.

horus.s_conc: The largest district shares of portfolio value are {list}.
horus.s_market_cooling: {n} districts are cooling on the sample series: {list}.
horus.s_market_synthetic: These are synthetic sample series generated for this demo, not CBE or CAPMAS figures.
horus.s_val_head: Valuation {id} for {asset}: model estimate {est}, final value {final}, range {low} to {high}, confidence {conf}.
horus.s_val_adjust: A human adjustment of {pct} was recorded. Reason: {reason}
horus.s_asset: {name} ({id}) is a {type} in {district}, valued at {value} against a cost of {cost}. Status: {status}.
horus.s_asset_risk: Its risk score is {score} out of 100, which is {band}.
horus.s_asset_lease: The lease with {tenant} ({id}) ends {end}, in {left} days.
horus.s_draft_body: As of {date}, the portfolio holds {count} assets valued at {value}, which is {gain} above cost. {units} assets are let, and the net yield over the last 12 months is {yield}. {vacant} units are vacant, {expiring} leases end within 120 days and {docs} documents need attention. All figures in this update come from sample data.
horus.s_draft_intro: I have drafted an investor update from the portfolio data. Review it, then save it as a draft for approval.
horus.s_draft_denied: Only asset managers can draft investor updates.
horus.s_file_scripted: This is a quick reading without the AI model. Ask about a specific clause once live answers are on, or open the file to read it in full.
horus.s_snooze: There are {n} open alerts. The most urgent is {kind} at {asset} ({id}), severity {severity}. I have prepared a snooze for you to confirm.
horus.s_snooze_none: There are no open alerts to snooze.
horus.s_snooze_reason: Snoozed from Horus while the team follows up
horus.s_action_denied: Only a manager can do that. I can still answer questions about the data.
horus.s_startval: {name} ({id}) is on record at {value}. I have prepared a new valuation with its facts filled in; open it to run the model and review the result.
horus.s_email_intro: I have drafted an email with the latest portfolio figures. Check it, then send it or dismiss it.
horus.s_email_body:
Dear Karim,

The portfolio holds {count} assets valued at {value}, {gain} above cost. {expiring} leases end within 120 days, and the team is preparing renewals.

All figures come from sample data.

Kind regards,
{name}

cite.missing: This record is not available to your role or no longer exists.

pack.currencyLine: Figures shown in {cur}. Sample FX rate: 1 USD = {rate} EGP.
pack.sampleBox: Everything in this pack is synthetic sample data from a concept demo. It is not real client, tenant or market data, and it is not an offer or advice.
pack.summaryLead: Where the portfolio stands at the data date.
pack.narrative: As of {date}, the portfolio holds {count} assets valued at {value}, which is {gain} above cost. {units} assets are let and the net yield over the last 12 months is {yield}. {vacant} units are vacant.
pack.yieldNote: Net yield is an aggregate over the whole portfolio. Income and costs of individual assets are not part of this pack.
pack.perfLead: Portfolio value rose {change} over the last 36 months.
pack.perfNote: Monthly value of every asset held in that month, following each district's sample price index. Cost steps up when an asset is acquired.
pack.riskLead: The six assets with the highest scores. Scores come from a deterministic model (AS-RISK-1.1.0).
pack.riskNote: Scores combine vacancy, lease expiry, documents, currency exposure, concentration and scenario pressure. Weights are sample values.
pack.valLead: Confirmed valuations, most recent first. Each was proposed by one person and confirmed by a different one.
pack.auditLead: Every action in ZMNHOOF OS is written to a hash-chained log: each event stores the hash of the one before it. This pack was issued at the chain position below. Finance-related events are listed.
pack.contentHash: Content hash (SHA-256 of this pack's contents)
pack.verification: Verification hash (content hash bound to the chain head)
pack.verifyHow: To verify, enter the verification hash on the Governance page of ZMNHOOF OS. It confirms this pack was issued and that the audit chain still contains the head shown above.

scn.title: Scenarios
scn.lead: Move the sliders and every asset's value, yield and risk recalculates. The low and high cases bracket your central case. Everything is deterministic, versioned and reproducible.
scn.setHelp: Coefficients and case offsets are versioned. A saved scenario keeps the version it used.
scn.lowHint: Adverse offsets: pound {fx}, rate +{rate}, vacancy +{vac}, rent growth {g}
scn.highHint: Favourable offsets: pound +{fx}, rate {rate}, vacancy {vac}, rent growth +{g}
scn.runError: The scenario could not be recalculated. Try again.
scn.sortNote: Sorted by the size of the central change.
scn.name: Name
scn.needManager: Only asset managers can save scenarios. You can still run scenarios and reproduce saved ones.
scn.nameError: Give the scenario a name of 3 to 60 characters.
scn.params: Pound {fx}, rate {rate}%, vacancy shock {vac}%, rent growth {g}%
scn.repIdentical: Reproduced exactly. The result hash {hash} matches when computed again from assumption set {set}.
scn.repBase: Inputs and assumptions are identical, but the portfolio data has changed since this was saved (for example a confirmed valuation), so the numbers now differ.
scn.repAssump: Warning: assumption set {set} no longer matches the hash recorded when this was saved.
scn.repFail: The scenario could not be reproduced.
scn.regLead: Every scenario points at one version. Publishing a new version never changes an old one.
scn.incomeW: Share of a let asset's value tied to rent
scn.regNote: Reason for the change (at least 10 characters)
scn.published: Published {id}. It is now the default for new runs.
scn.publishError: Check the values and give a reason of at least 10 characters.
scn.managerOnly: Only asset managers can publish a new version.
scn.how1: Interest rate: each point of policy rate adds {cap} points to the cap rate, which lowers value. The effect is kept between 60% and 160% of base value.
scn.how2: Vacancy: for let assets, {w}% of value is tied to rent, so a vacancy shock removes that share of income and value.
scn.how3: Rent growth: growth above or below the base moves let assets by {w}% of value times a pass-through of {r}.
scn.how4: Pound: value moves with the pound by each asset's dollar linkage, highest for dollar-denominated leases. Dollar rents convert at the scenario rate.
scn.how5: Risk: vacancy shock, currency moves, district concentration and value pressure all feed each asset's risk score.
scn.fromPortfolio: Scenario tools sit with the portfolio.

docs.title: Documents
docs.lead: See what is missing or running out, and read the bundled sample documents into the record. The reader works on three sample documents only.
docs.dropHelp: Drop a PDF here or choose a file. This demo reads only its three bundled sample documents. Any other file is refused.
docs.refused: This demo reads only its three bundled sample documents. That file is not one of them, so nothing was read.
docs.investorNote: Reading a document shows rents and is available to asset managers. Everyone can see the document flags above.
docs.engine: Sample extraction ({engine}). Rule-based on the PDF text layer, not an AI model.
docs.conflict: English says {en}, Arabic says {ar}. Choose the right one.
docs.confirmHelp: Nothing is written until you confirm. Fields marked Check, and any you edit, must be ticked first.
docs.confirmedOk: Record updated. {n} change(s) applied and written to the audit log.
docs.noChange: Nothing needed changing. The document is now marked verified.
docs.alreadyConfirmed: Confirmed earlier. Confirming again re-applies the values shown.
docs.err_unchecked: Tick every field marked Check, and every field you edited.
docs.err_invalid: One of the values is not valid. Check dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and numbers.
docs.err_not_sample: That is not one of the bundled sample documents.
docs.err_not_found: The record for this document could not be found.

packui.title: Investor pack
packui.lead: A branded PDF with summary, performance, allocation, risks, valuation changes and an audit appendix with a verification hash.
packui.note: Generated on demand. Each pack is logged in the audit chain and gets a verification hash.
packui.verifyHelp: Paste the verification hash from a pack's audit appendix. This confirms the pack was issued by this system and that the audit chain still contains the head it was bound to. It reveals no content.
packui.found: Issued as {id} ({lang}) on {date}, by the {role} role, bound to audit event {seq}.
packui.notFound: No pack with that hash was issued by this system.
packui.chainOk: The audit chain still contains the head this pack was bound to.
packui.chainBroken: Warning: the audit chain no longer matches the head this pack was bound to.
packui.matchedContent: That is the content hash. The verification hash in the appendix also binds the pack to the audit chain.

al.title: Alerts and approvals
al.lead: What needs a person: approvals routed to your role, and alerts the data raises by itself. An alert clears when its cause is fixed. You can snooze one with a reason.
al.approvalsLead: Items routed to your role. Nobody decides something they proposed.
al.noApprovals: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
al.t_valuation_drift: Comparable sales sit {pct} from the recorded value of {asset}.
al.t_vacancy_cost: {asset} has been vacant for {days} days, costing about {cost} in rent so far.
al.onlyManagers: Only asset managers can snooze alerts.
al.err_not_found: That alert is no longer raised.
al.err_reason_required: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
al.confirmedMsg: Confirmed. The portfolio value has been updated.
al.blockedRole: This item is routed to the {role} role, so you cannot decide it.
al.blockedSelf: You proposed this, so you cannot decide it. A different person must.
al.demoRecorded: Demo: the decision is recorded in the audit log. No role actually changes.
al.err_self_approval: You proposed this, so you cannot decide it.
al.feedNote: A simulated stream for the demo. These events are not real, are not stored, and change no record.
al.feedEmpty: Waiting for the next simulated event.
al.f_valuation: Model refresh: the value indication for {asset} moved {pct}.
al.snoozeReasonN: Reason for snoozing all {n} (at least 10 characters)
al.snoozedN: Alerts snoozed: {n}. Each is recorded in the audit chain.
al.a_distribution: {id} for {period}: {amount} on net operating income of {noi}.

gov2.audLead: Every write is recorded. Each event stores the hash of the one before it, so an edit anywhere breaks the chain from that point on.
gov2.audAdminOnly: The audit log is visible to the administrator only. The permission matrix above shows who can do what.
gov2.verifyPass: Chain verified: {n} events, every hash recomputed and every link matched. Head: {head}.
gov2.verifyFail: Chain broken at event {seq} (position {idx}). Expected {exp} but found {found}.
gov2.verifyFailLink: Chain broken at event {seq} (position {idx}): its link to the previous event does not match.
gov2.tamperHelp: Demo only. Edits one stored event behind the chain's back, as someone with database access could, so you can watch Verify chain catch it. The act is logged with the original content, so it can be undone.
gov2.tamperedMsg: Event {seq} was edited directly in the database. Now verify the chain.
gov2.restoredMsg: The event was restored. Verify the chain again.
gov2.err_already_tampered: The chain is already broken. Restore it first.
gov2.err_forbidden: Only the administrator can do this.
gov2.chainPosture: The audit chain verifies: every event's hash matches its content and its link.
gov2.chainPostureBad: The audit chain does not verify. An event was changed after it was written.
gov2.resetHelp: Demo only. Removes everything people changed and loads the original sample data with a fresh audit chain.
gov2.resetDone: Demo data reset. The audit chain starts again.
gov2.resetWrong: Type RESET in capitals to confirm.
gov2.stripLabel: The latest events, each linked to the one before by its hash

pub.title: Ask about ZMNHOOF OS
pub.subtitle: Answers from our product guide. No account needed.
pub.welcome: Hello. Ask anything about ZMNHOOF OS, or request a demo with your own portfolio.
pub.pub_q_security: How is the data kept secure?
pub.noMatch: Our guide does not cover that. Request a demo and the team will answer it directly.

pub.leadIntro: Leave your details and the team will contact you to arrange a demo with your portfolio.
pub.f_message: What would you like to see? (optional)
pub.leadPrivacy: We use these details only to reply to you. In this demo nothing is emailed; the request appears in the team's outbox.
pub.leadRate: Too many requests from this connection. Please try again later.
pub.sentTitle: Thank you. Your request is in.
pub.sentBody: The team will contact you by email. A confirmation is in our outbox (this demo sends no real email).

outbox.title: Demo requests and outbox
outbox.lead: Requests from the sign-in chat, and every email the app would send. In this demo nothing leaves the server.

decide.rejectEffect: Rejecting returns it to the proposer and changes no values. Say why, so they can act on it.
decide.effectConfirm: This is the final approval: the valuation is confirmed and the decision is written to the audit chain.
decide.effectConfirmAsset: This is the final approval: the asset's value, the portfolio totals and the next investor pack change, and the decision is written to the audit chain.
decide.effectPartial: Your approval is recorded. Approvals still needed after yours: {n}. No value changes until then.
decide.effectPublish: Approving publishes this update to investors and records the decision in the audit chain.
decide.effectRole: Approving records the role change in the audit chain. In this demo it does not change the person's access.
decide.audited: Your name, the time and your note are written to the audit chain.
decide.doneConfirmed: {id} is approved. Recorded as audit event #{seq}.
decide.donePartial: Your approval of {id} is recorded as audit event #{seq}. It now waits for another manager.
decide.doneRejected: {id} is rejected. Recorded as audit event #{seq}.
decide.err_self_approval: You proposed this, so a different person must decide it.
decide.effectDistribution: Approving lets a manager pay this distribution to investors. The decision is written to the audit chain.

lease.title: Tenants and leases
lease.lead: {tenants} tenants on {leases} leases: who pays, who owes, and which leases need renewing.
lease.renewalsLead: Leases ending within {days} days, and any renewal already under way, grouped by stage.
lease.noRenewals: No lease ends within the window.
lease.investorNote: Rents and proposed terms are visible to asset managers only.
lease.renewalRule: An offer or an agreement needs a proposed rent. The new end date must be after the current one.
lease.renewalInvalid: Check the stage, rent and date: an offer or agreement needs a rent, and the new end must be after the current end.
lease.renewalSaved: Renewal updated. Recorded as audit event #{seq}.
lease.currencyNote: Amounts in pounds; dollar leases are converted at the sample rate. Rent is due on the fifth of each month.
lease.audited: The payment and your name are written to the audit chain. Payments cannot be edited afterwards.
lease.paidInFull: Paid in full. Recorded as audit event #{seq}.
lease.paidPart: Part payment recorded; EGP {left} still owed. Audit event #{seq}.
lease.reminded: Reminder placed in the outbox as {id} (audit event #{seq}).
lease.err_forbidden: Only asset managers can do this.
lease.err_too_much: That is more than is owed on this invoice.
lease.err_reminded_recently: A reminder went out less than a week ago.
lease.err_no_contact: This tenant has no contact on file.

fin.title: Cash flow and finance
fin.lead: Income, costs and net operating income, the year against budget, the next twelve months, and distributions to investors.
fin.leadInvestor: The distributions paid to you, and the ones on their way.
fin.forecastLead: Each lease pays its rent until it ends; after that at the proposed rent if a renewal is under way, at the current rent if not started, and nothing if the tenant is leaving. Costs are the last twelve months' average.
fin.ledgerLead: Lease income and costs by month, and every line entered by hand. Income is green, costs are red.
fin.amountHelp: Always positive: the category decides whether it is income or a cost.
fin.auditedEntry: Ledger lines cannot be edited or deleted; a correction is a new line. Each is written to the audit chain.
fin.budgetLead: Each category this year so far. A shortfall is income below budget or costs above it.
fin.budgetNote: Costs are shown as positive amounts. The budget is the sample 2026 budget.
fin.distLead: Paid to investors so far: {total}. Each quarter's distribution is proposed by a manager and approved by a different one.
fin.nextLine: Net operating income for the quarter was {noi}. Suggested distribution: {suggested} (80% after a 5% reserve).
fin.basis: Sized on {noi} of net operating income ({pct}).
fin.proposeHelp: The quarter's net operating income was {noi}. The amount may not exceed it.
fin.proposeRule: A different manager must approve it on Alerts and approvals before it can be paid.
fin.proposed: {id} sent for approval as {approval}. Audit event #{seq}.
fin.paidMsg: Marked paid; the investor was notified through the outbox. Audit event #{seq}.
fin.err_forbidden: Only asset managers can do this.
fin.err_invalid: Check the amount, date and description.
fin.err_too_much: That is more than the quarter's net operating income.
fin.err_already_proposed: This quarter's distribution has already been proposed.
fin.err_not_approved: Only an approved distribution can be marked paid.

work.title: Maintenance and tasks
work.lead: Every repair and team task: who has it, when it is due, what it costs. Overdue work is outlined in red.
work.leadInvestor: Repairs and work under way on your assets. Report a problem and the managers will pick it up.
work.reportNote: A manager will set the priority, assign it and keep you posted on the timeline.
work.boardNote: Done shows the last 45 days. Cancelled work stays on each work order's page.
work.actualHelp: Written to the finance ledger as a maintenance cost. Leave empty if there was no cost.
work.completedLedger: Done; the cost is in the ledger as {entry}. Audit event #{seq}.
work.ev_completedCost: {who} marked it done at a cost of {amount}
work.err_invalid: Check the details: a maintenance request needs an asset, a title of at least four characters, and a due date that is not in the past.
work.err_not_found: That work order no longer exists.
work.assetNone: No work recorded on this asset.

rep.title: Reports and exports
rep.lead: Download the data you can see as Excel or CSV, investor statements as PDF, and reports sent on a schedule.
rep.exportsLead: Each file holds exactly what your role sees on screen, in the language you are using now.
rep.exportsNote: Amounts are in Egyptian pounds as plain numbers, so they add up in a spreadsheet. Every download is recorded in the audit chain.
rep.statementsLead: A PDF of the portfolio's value, net operating income, distributions and holdings for the period.
rep.statementsNote: Statements show the portfolio in aggregate: never a single asset's rent or costs. Each is recorded with a fingerprint of its content.
rep.scheduleLead: Reports built and sent on a date each month or quarter. In this demo they go to the outbox; nothing is emailed.
rep.name: Name
rep.recipientsHelp: Up to ten email addresses, separated by commas.
rep.kHelp_workbook_management: Built with your permissions: rent, costs and contacts included. Send it to managers only.
rep.kHelp_workbook_investor: Always built with the investor's permissions, so it never carries rent, costs or contacts.
rep.kHelp_statement: The year-to-date investor statement as a PDF.
rep.ranMsg: Built {run} and sent to {n} recipients. Next run {next}.
rep.err_invalid: Check the name, the sheets and the email addresses.
rep.pdfNoDist: No distribution was paid in this period.
rep.pdfAggregateNote: Portfolio totals only. Single assets' rents and costs are not shown in investor statements.
rep.pdfFooter: Data as of {date}. Sample data throughout: not real clients, tenants or market data.
rep.dsHelp_holdings: Every asset with its district, type, occupancy, value and cost.
rep.dsHelp_leases: Every lease with its dates and renewal stage; managers also get rent and arrears.
rep.dsHelp_rent: Every unpaid invoice with what is owed and how many days overdue.
rep.dsHelp_ledger: Every income and cost line, from leases and entered by hand.
rep.dsHelp_budget: This year's budget by category against the actual figures.
rep.dsHelp_work: Every work order with its status, priority, assignee and due date.
rep.dsHelp_distributions: Every distribution with its quarter, amount and status.
rep.dsHelp_audit: Every event in the audit chain with its hash and the hash before it.

ntf.title: Notifications
ntf.lead: What needs you, and what happened to the things you started. Choose how you hear about each kind under Settings.
ntf.prefsLead: For each kind of notification, choose whether it appears here, is emailed to you, or both.
ntf.emailNote: In this demo, email goes to the outbox on Governance; nothing is sent.
ntf.cHelp_approvals: Something waits for your decision, or a decision on what you proposed.
ntf.cHelp_work: Work assigned to you, reported by an investor, or finished.
ntf.cHelp_sales: New demo requests from the sign-in page.
ntf.k_approval_request: {what, select, valuation {Valuation} distribution {Distribution} update {Investor update} other {Item}} {id} is waiting for your approval
ntf.b_approval_request: Proposed by someone else, so you may decide it.
ntf.k_approval_decided: {id} was {outcome, select, approved {approved} confirmed {approved} rejected {rejected} other {decided}}
ntf.cHelp_calendar: Invitations to meetings and inspections, and changes to them.

cal.title: Calendar
cal.lead: Meetings, inspections and deadlines, with every date the portfolio already knows: leases ending, rent due, work due and payouts.
cal.deleteConfirm: Cancel this event and tell the people invited?
cal.fSharedHelp: Investors see shared events, and any event they are invited to.
cal.d_rent_due: {n, plural, one {# rent invoice due} other {# rent invoices due}}
cal.gridCaption: {month}, one row per week, Sunday first
cal.emptyMonth: Nothing on the calendar this month.
cal.next7None: Nothing in the next seven days.
cal.deleted: {id} was cancelled. The people invited have been told.
cal.created: {id} is in the calendar. The people invited have been told.
cal.noteManager: Rent due and scheduled reports are shown to managers only. Weekends (Friday and Saturday) are shaded.
cal.noteInvestor: You see shared events, events you are invited to, leases ending, work due and your distributions.
cal.eventNote: Changes and cancellations are recorded in the audit trail.
cal.err_forbidden: Your role cannot change the calendar.
cal.err_invalid: Check the details: something is missing or not allowed.
cal.err_past: The date has passed. Pick today or later.
cal.err_times: Give a start time, and an end after it, or mark it all day.
